svg.title: Run 2, "What does Super Tuscan mean?". The menu search found the Sassicaia 2018 entry, which mentions Super Tuscan but never explains it. Its four strips scored 0.00, 0.00, 0.30 and 0.20, all under the cutoff, so nothing was kept. The graph rewrote the question for the web, found wine-searcher.com and wsetglobal.com, and answered from them: a Tuscan red made outside the traditional grape rules.
